name: cavemio-switch
title: Switch
description: A switch with weight: the thumb stretches on press, is thrown across with a slight overshoot, and spins while an async save settles.

cavemio.usage:
import { Switch } from "@/components/switch";

<Switch
  label="Weekly digest"
  description="A summary every Monday."
  labelPosition="start"
  defaultChecked
  onCheckedChange={(on) => saveSetting("digest", on)}
/>
cavemio.accessibility:
- Reduced motion: the thumb moves at once and nothing shakes.
- While pending, aria-busy is set and further presses are ignored.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: onCheckedChange
props.description: – · Return a promise for the pending thumb; reject to put it back.

features.title: Async without wiring
features.description: Return a promise from onCheckedChange: pending spinner, then settled or thrown back.

features.title: Weight in the motion
features.description: The thumb stretches 4px on press and is thrown with an overshoot (420ms).

features.title: role="switch"
features.description: aria-checked and aria-busy, Space and Enter.

features.title: Label either side
features.description: labelPosition="start" for settings rows with the switch on the right.

states.title: off / on
states.description: The thumb is thrown across (420ms, slight overshoot) and the primary fill fades in (260ms).

states.title: press
states.description: The thumb stretches 4px toward its next side.

states.title: pending
states.description: The thumb shows a spinner; the switch ignores presses.

states.title: failed
states.description: The thumb is thrown back and the track shakes (320ms).
